title: QA / Software Tester
excerpt: Execute manual and automated testing across E-GEAD's web and fulfillment platform systems.
description:
We are seeking a QA / Software Tester to maintain high software quality across our e-commerce orchestration and warehouse management platforms.

  • Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios.
  • Perform regression testing, API testing, and UI validation across web applications.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product squads to ensure defect-free deployments.
requirements:
• Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in software testing (manual and automated).
  • Proficient in API testing tools (Postman) and web automation frameworks.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and effective team communication.
benefits:
• Competitive salary based on capability + quarterly performance bonus.
  • Comprehensive health insurance and annual medical checkups.
  • Dynamic international work environment with modern equipment (MacBook Pro).

title: Senior Performance Marketing Lead (US / EU Markets)
excerpt: Lead high-scale digital marketing campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads with large monthly ad budgets.
description:
E-GEAD is looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Lead to strategize and execute high-converting paid acquisition campaigns in Tier-1 markets (US, UK, AU, DE).

  • Directly manage and optimize scalable ad budgets across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads.
  • Develop rigorous A/B testing methodologies for creatives, landing pages, and conversion hooks.
  • Analyze ROI/ROAS, CPA, and LTV metrics to optimize multi-channel budget allocation.
  • Mentor and lead an enthusiastic team of media buyers.
requirements:
• At least 3 years of hands-on experience running ads in US/EU markets (Cross-Border, POD, Dropshipping, or D2C Brands).
  • Demonstrated experience managing monthly ad spend of $50,000+ with consistent ROAS.
  • Deep understanding of tracking attribution (GA4, CAPI, Triple Whale).
  • Sharp creative mindset, viral hooks mastery, and deep understanding of Western consumer psychology.
benefits:
• Competitive base salary + uncapped high-performance bonus.
  • 100% remote work with flexible hours.
  • Opportunities to attend international affiliate and e-commerce conferences.

title: Global Supply Chain & Logistics Specialist
excerpt: Coordinate manufacturing supply chains and cross-border carrier networks with USPS, FedEx, and UPS.
description:
The Global Supply Chain & Logistics Specialist coordinates freight flows from manufacturing facilities to sorting hubs and central fulfillment warehouses across the United States.

  • Forecast material demands and coordinate production schedules against order volume.
  • Negotiate and liaise with global shipping carriers (USPS, FedEx, DHL, UPS) to optimize freight cost and transit times.
  • Manage 2-4 day domestic delivery SLAs in the US and resolve customs or carrier exceptions.
requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, International Trade, or equivalent.
  • At least 2 years of experience in international logistics or e-commerce fulfillment operations.
  • Proficiency in Excel and modern ERP/WMS systems.
  • Strong negotiation skills, rapid problem-solving, and resilience during peak holiday seasons (Q4).
benefits:
• Competitive salary based on capability ($800 - $1,200 USD).
  • Full health insurance coverage and statutory benefits.
  • 13th-month salary bonus + supply chain performance incentives.
  • Dynamic, professional work culture adhering to global operational standards.

title: E-Commerce Account Manager (Amazon & TikTok Shop US)
excerpt: Manage and scale storefront revenue across TikTok Shop US and Amazon US leveraging E-GEAD's sub-24h fulfillment infrastructure.
description:
E-GEAD is seeking a driven E-Commerce Account Manager to spearhead storefront operations and revenue growth for cross-border catalog lines in the US market.

  • Directly operate storefronts on TikTok Shop US and Amazon (FBM/FBA).
  • Conduct winning product research, optimize SEO listings, and implement high-converting imagery and video creatives.
  • Monitor and safeguard account health metrics (Late Dispatch Rate < 1%, Order Defect Rate < 0.5%).
  • Plan promotional campaigns, Flash Sales, and collaborate with ad teams to maximize ROAS.
requirements:
• At least 2 years of proven experience managing Amazon US or TikTok Shop US stores.
  • Thorough grasp of US marketplace policies, search algorithms, and fulfillment protocols.
  • Strong quantitative skills, data analytics proficiency, and customer escalation management.
  • Fluent English communication and writing skills (equivalent to IELTS 6.5+).
benefits:
• Attractive base salary + performance commission (Average total income: $1,800 - $2,500+).
  • Access to substantial product testing budgets and proprietary US fulfillment networks.
  • Annual company retreats, team-building events, and holiday bonuses.
  • Vibrant, innovative international environment encouraging new ideas and testing.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Next.js & Node.js)
excerpt: Architect and scale E-GEAD's proprietary WMS and commerce orchestration platform serving millions of cross-border orders to US & EU markets.
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Fullstack Engineer to develop and scale E-GEAD's core software systems. You will design real-time data architectures integrating deeply with Amazon, TikTok Shop, Shopify, and our US warehousing network.

  • Build modern web applications with Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, and Node.js.
  • Design highly scalable databases (PostgreSQL, Redis) and resilient event-driven architectures.
  • Optimize API throughput, data security, and sub-second order synchronization pipelines.
  • Collaborate with Product and DevOps teams for continuous delivery via automated CI/CD pipelines.
requirements:
• At least 4 years of in-depth experience with TypeScript, React/Next.js, and Node.js.
  • Proficiency in RESTful APIs, WebSocket protocols, and microservices/event-driven architectures.
  • Hands-on experience optimizing relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/Redis caches.
  • Excellent problem-solving mindset, proactive initiative, and strong ownership.
  • Prior experience in E-Commerce, Logistics WMS, or Cross-Border platforms is strongly preferred.
benefits:
• Competitive compensation: $1,500 - $2,500 USD + quarterly performance bonuses.
  • Flexible hybrid work arrangement with high-spec equipment (latest MacBook Pro M-series).
  • Premium private health insurance for employee and dependents.
  • Travel, training, and exchange opportunities with international tech partners in the US.
  • Bi-annual performance and salary reviews with clear Technical Lead career pathways.
